lines.text: Tesla's sales held steady. Its profit still fell 43%.
lines.say: Tesla's sales held steady. Its profit still fell forty-three percent.

lines.text: Wednesday after the bell, Tesla reported about $28 billion in sales, flat from a year earlier.
lines.say: Wednesday after the bell, Tesla reported about twenty-eight billion dollars in sales, flat from a year earlier.

lines.text: But net income dropped from $1.37 billion to $787 million.
lines.say: But net income dropped from one point three seven billion dollars to seven hundred eighty-seven million.

lines.text: Adjusted earnings still beat: 48 cents a share, versus about 44 cents expected.
lines.say: Adjusted earnings still beat: forty-eight cents a share, versus about forty-four cents expected.

lines.text: So what ate the profit? Research spending jumped 69%, to $2.76 billion.
lines.say: So what ate the profit? Research spending jumped sixty-nine percent, to two point seven six billion dollars.

lines.text: Tesla says that money goes into AI, its Optimus robot and the Cybercab, and that it weighs on profit.
lines.say: Tesla says that money goes into AI, its Optimus robot and the Cybercab, and that it weighs on profit.

lines.text: The bright spots: gross margin rose, and free cash flow was about $1.5 billion.
lines.say: The bright spots: gross margin rose, and free cash flow was about one point five billion dollars.

lines.text: If you own an S&P 500 index fund, you own a slice of Tesla and its big bets.
lines.say: If you own an S and P five hundred index fund, you own a slice of Tesla and its big bets.

post.ig:
Tesla's sales held steady. Its profit still fell 43%.
Tesla's Q3 2026 revenue was about $28B, flat from a year earlier (reported Oct 21, 2026).
Net income fell to $787M from $1.37B. Adjusted EPS of 48 cents beat estimates of about 44 cents.
Research spending jumped 69% to $2.76B as Tesla spends on AI, Optimus and the Cybercab. Free cash flow was about $1.5B.
Sources: Tesla Q3 2026 update and SEC 8-K (Oct 21, 2026), Electrek, StockTitan, investingLive.
